This is software/integration evidence, not formal electrical_measurement or physical_inspection; S45 and mechanism calibration remain inconclusive.
1000-2000us is an initial bounded test range, not measured servo endpoints or an angle guarantee. Width/frequency/current/force/position remain unmeasured.
Local profiles are manual browser records, not ESP NVS or production calibration. Saving requires a completed calibration command, matching target and explicit human action.
Software Stop depends on a responsive control loop, USB/I2C and successful FULL_OFF write; it does not remove5V or guarantee torque release.
Native WebMCP tests did not submit Arm or movement. Timeout/abort/3000ms duration behavior was checked in deterministic tests, not a powered servo test.
